notes.title: 《ReEarth》31.7.2024 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Update Announcement[/b]

Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support. We are excited to bring you the latest game update. Here are the details of the new content:

1. Fixed the bug where game settings could not be saved.
2. Added unit exit direction to factory silhouettes in build mode.
3. Optimized mini-map orientation.
4. Fixed the laser turret range bug.
5. Fixed bugs preventing certain achievements from being unlocked.
6. Fixed various UI display bugs.
7. Reduced the collision size of all units to improve pathfinding.
8. Optimized the pathfinding logic for Zerg.
9. Adjusted various game values.
10. Added a new tutorial level.

Additionally, we will be adding the usernames of players who have actively provided bug feedback and suggestions to our credits. We appreciate their contributions to improving our game!

notes.title: Game Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that our independent RTS game, ReEarth, is now officially released! It has been a long and challenging journey of development, and today we finally reach this exciting milestone.

ReEarth is a real-time strategy game that blends strategic depth with science fiction elements. In the game, you will take on the role of a commander leading humanity back to the long-lost Earth, facing unknown challenges and enemies while rebuilding human civilization. The game is designed to offer a deep strategic experience, rich storylines, and stunning visuals. We hope every player finds their own enjoyment in the game.

We understand that a great game thrives on the support and feedback from its players. Therefore, we commit to continuously collecting your feedback and attentively listening to every player. Our development team will closely monitor community discussions and promptly fix any issues within the game. We also plan to release a series of updates in the future, bringing more content and a better gaming experience to all of you. [url=https://discord.gg/sSnYyYTy]>Tap to contact us<[/url]

To express our gratitude for your support, we will be hosting a series of events on social media platforms and our official community, including Q&A sessions, player suggestion collections, giveaways, and more. We hope you will actively participate and help us improve ReEarth together.

Thank you once again to every player who has supported and followed ReEarth. Your enthusiasm and suggestions are the greatest driving force for us. We hope ReEarth brings you endless joy and an exciting gaming experience. Let’s create the future together on this hopeful planet!

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in ReEarth!
